verdict: Lead costs nearly doubled this week; budget shift and overdue channels are the cause.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 120 leads at an average cost of $5.87 per lead, but the most recent 7 days showed a sharp drop — leads fell 55% week-over-week while cost per lead rose 93%. The immediate cause is a budget concentration: the majority of this period's spend ($545 of $704 total) ran through an awareness-stage campaign that generates softer conversion rates than bottom-funnel placements. A three-day gap in spend (Sep 20–22) further disrupted momentum, and site traffic has not yet recovered to prior levels. Budget allocation is being rebalanced toward conversion-focused placements, and the overdue channel buildout — including search and local ads — is being escalated so you are not relying on a single campaign type to carry lead volume.

watch_item.issue: All 10 planned channel milestones — including search campaigns, local service ads, and CRM automation — remain undelivered, leaving Meta as your only active lead source.
watch_item.fix: These are being escalated as the immediate priority; activating even one additional channel this month will reduce your exposure to single-channel swings like the one seen this week.
